name: FloorGuard Rules API
description: Read-only JSON API with sourced prop-firm drawdown and daily-loss rules (9 firms, 13 programs) and a drawdown-room checker. This is a plain HTTPS REST API described by OpenAPI 3.1 at https://floorguard-kappa.vercel.app/api/v1/openapi.json: call its GET endpoints directly (no A2A task or message methods). No authentication. Free tier about 60 requests/minute per IP; no payments yet. Informational only, not financial advice. Prop firms change rules often; always verify every value with the firm's current terms and your account dashboard. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any prop firm.

skills.name: List firms
skills.description: List supported prop firms and programs with program ids, account sizes, verified flags and last-verified dates. GET https://floorguard-kappa.vercel.app/api/v1/firms

skills.name: Get rules
skills.description: Full daily-loss and max-drawdown rules for one program (reset time, notes, official source links, firm copy-trading and automation policy). GET https://floorguard-kappa.vercel.app/api/v1/rules?program=<id>

skills.name: Check drawdown room
skills.description: Remaining daily-loss and max-drawdown room in dollars for an account, the binding limit, and whether a rule is breached. GET https://floorguard-kappa.vercel.app/api/v1/check?program=&accountSize=&currentEquity=[&todayPnl&highWaterMark&...]
